title: Ticket prices and visit booking
intro: Tickets are purchased at the entrance to the Gallery of the Natural History Museum on Mali Kalemegdan.
body:
Gallery opening hours:

- Tuesday – Sunday, 10:00–21:00 (4 May – 31 October)
- Tuesday – Sunday, 10:00–18:00 (1 November – 30 April)
- Closed on Mondays
- Thursdays free admission 10:00–12:00

Group visits and guided tours can be arranged by phone on 011 3284 317 or by e-mail at galerija@nhmbeo.rs.
